summary: A row of StatTiles, as a description list. Wraps on its own — no breakpoints in the caller's code.
useWhen: two or more headline figures shown side by side

useInstead.when: the figures are rows of records to compare field by field

composition.note: StatGroup renders the <dl>; each StatTile renders a <dt> and a <dd> inside it. A StatTile outside a StatGroup is invalid HTML.
composition.example: <StatGroup><StatTile label="Runs" value="1.2k" change={4.1} goodWhen="neutral" /><StatTile label="Median run time" value="38s" change={-6.2} goodWhen="down" /></StatGroup>

children.note: StatTiles only — the group is a <dl>, so anything else inside it is invalid

guarantees: a <dl>, so each label is announced as the term for its figure
notes: Give the group a heading or aria-label when the page has more than one, so a screen reader can tell them apart.

antiPatterns.dont: adding media queries to change the column count
antiPatterns.why: the grid already wraps by tile width; a breakpoint fights it
